item.title: Microsoft signs 1.2 GW capacity agreement with Example Data Centers in Busan
item.description: Microsoft has signed a 1.2 GW capacity agreement with Example Data Centers for a campus in Busan, the companies said on Monday.

item.title: Korea Electric Power opens 345 kV substation for the Saemangeum data center cluster
item.description: KEPCO energised a new 345 kV substation serving the Saemangeum cluster, adding 1 GW of connection capacity.

item.title: Example Data Centers announces 300 MW Incheon campus
item.description: Example Data Centers today announced a 300 MW hyperscale campus in Incheon, with the first 60 MW phase scheduled to reach ready-for-service in the fourth quarter of 2028. The company said the site has secured a grid connection agreement with the utility and will use direct-to-chip liquid cooling for AI workloads, with a design PUE below 1.2. Construction financing is being arranged with a consortium of Korean lenders, and anchor tenant discussions are under way with two hyperscale cloud providers.

item.title: NVIDIA, SK hynix expand HBM4 supply deal — report
item.description: NVIDIA and SK hynix have expanded their HBM4 supply agreement for 2027, a report said.
